text:
Omar Chen: Quick sync — proposing a new customer tag taxonomy + playbook triggers for an 'engagement-index' (low/medium/high). Doc: https://docs.internal/r/redwood/cs/tagging-proposal Please review by EOD Fri.
Priya Patel: Saw the doc — looks sensible. Q: how do we handle multi-org customers with multiple org_ids? we currently dedupe on email and account_id.
Omar Chen: Good call. Proposal is to tag at account_id (canonical) and also add an 'org_alias' tag for per-org nuance. Backfill will set both where applicable.
Maya Reyes: Can we map those tags into deterministic health-index buckets? need exact thresholds so renewal alerts are consistent.
Ben Liu: Mapping table is in the doc under "Tag -> HealthIndex". For the backfill I can run a batch job. Example command: ```./cs_backfill --source crm --tags new_taxonomy --batch 500 --rate 20``` Will start ramping slowly.
Jay Park: last time a backfill we hit API rate limits and caused brief write contention. Recommend ramp 50/s then increase, add retries and idempotency keys.
Priya Patel: SQL to find candidates without any tag (for playbook triggers): ```SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE last_activity > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_tags WHERE tag IN ('engaged','at-risk','churn-risk'))``` Use this as the default cohort.
Omar Chen: Priya — can you add a 200-row sample CSV for QA and a small set of example alerts that should invoke each playbook?
Priya Patel: Uploaded sample CSV to the doc and added three alert examples. :file_folder:
cs-bot: backfill job started by Ben Liu (job id: bf-20240214-7) — 0/10000 processed. ETA: ~3h.
Ben Liu: Ramp plan: start 50/s for first 30m, then 200/s if no 429s. Monitoring dashboards up. :eyes:
cs-bot: bf-20240214-7: 450/10000 processed, 0 errors.
Maya Reyes: Nice. If stable can we schedule weekly incremental backfills for new accounts rather than re-running full each time? that will cut repeat cost and churn.
Omar Chen: Agreed. Plan: one historic full backfill, then weekly delta via webhook + small daily incremental. I'll add that to the roadmap and calendar.
Priya Patel: One more ask — can we include a 'tag_change_reason' and 'applied_by' on account events so analysts can trace why a playbook fired? big help for renewal ops.
Ben Liu: Yep — adding to event schema v2. Will push sample event payload to the doc later today.
Omar Chen: Great. If no blockers I'll merge the proposal tomorrow morning and schedule the backfill for next Tue. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Maya Reyes: :+1:
Jay Park: :thumbsup:
cs-bot: bf-20240214-7: completed — 10,000 processed, 0 errors, duration 3h12m
